title: Chesterfield resident shows how she climbs through storm damage to get home - NewsBreak
text:
By Alexa Bonilla ,
1 days ago
CHESTERFIELD COUNTY, Va. (WRIC) — “Go over this,” said Savannah Kirwan, a Chesterfield County resident. “Watch out for that pole. Ta-da we made it.” Kirwan showed 8News how she does parkour to maneuver between the fallen trees on her driveway.
“Our whole front trees are down. There’s a tree in the garage,” Kirwan said. There are more than a dozen trees down in Kirwan’s yard.
The bottom of one tree is more than six feet tall. Last night’s severe thunderstorms caused more than 10,000 customers to be without power in Chesterfield alone. Winterpock Road between McEnally Road and Springford Parkway is still closed off.
Kirwan was at her parents’ house with her roommates last night when the storm hit. Her parents live about five minutes away from her, she said her parents’ house is completely fine.
“I didn’t even know it was supposed to be storming like I wasn’t expecting this at all,” Kirwan said.
Kirwan saw a drone image of a tree fallen right next to her house on social media. Her dog was inside so knew she had to get back home.
“I came here to check it out and couldn’t get in,” Kirwan said.
The damage caused powerlines to go down. Kirwan said crews have been out since last night working on repairs. Because of the damage, Kirwan’s street is blocked off. She has to park down the road and walk to her house. Once she gets to her property, she has to dodge powerlines and climb under and over trees to reach her front door. The trees right now are blocking her driveway.
“I parked my car and I walked through all the people and then just climbed,” Kirwan said.
Kirwan and her roommates are grateful they weren’t home when the storm struck. The only physical damage to the house is one broken window. However, they also don’t have water, power or heat. Kirwan and her roommates are staying with Kirwan’s parents for now.
Kirwan said she has no idea when the damage will be fixed. She thinks it’ll take months.
